assertions.assertion: Discover, confirm, and execute each resolve C05, enforce C06 TOOL_CALL, then resolve C05 again before Tenant admission.
assertions.evidence: Node behavior and C06 integration tests

assertions.assertion: Only three exact read-only Synthetic operation definitions and the fixed nine-row C0 fixture are accepted.
assertions.evidence: Catalog, fixture substitution, and negative parameter tests

assertions.assertion: Execute binds immutable parameters, catalog, adapter, Tenant lifecycle, C05 lifecycle and epochs, stable C06 authority, confirmation, and idempotency hashes.
assertions.evidence: Tamper, expiry, replay, lifecycle-drift, and policy-drift tests

assertions.assertion: A short-lived single-call Synthetic capability is passed only as a private Adapter argument and is absent from responses, errors, receipts, audit, and snapshots.
assertions.evidence: Credential lifecycle, malicious Adapter output, and serialized-output scans

assertions.assertion: The C0 Adapter performs no network request or real external side effect, and only exact operation results with a self-hashed zero-effect receipt can be persisted.
assertions.evidence: Strict result and receipt validation, Adapter counters, closed problem codes, and static scans

assertions.assertion: Metadata-only immutable audit intents retry the same intent after a lost publisher ACK.
Every C16 table has a Tenant key with FORCE RLS, while each pool has one exact role closure and one exact cross-aios schema, table, column, sequence, and function privilege matrix.
assertions.evidence: PostgreSQL 17 RLS, ADMIN OPTION, transitive-role, predefined-role, high-attribute, direct-grant, mixed-pool, and scope-cleanup tests

assertions.assertion: A fresh PostgreSQL system can restore pending and completed C16 state and resume audit publication.
assertions.evidence: pg_dump and pg_restore test on a different system identifier
